title: Editable data tables, search and time series
summary: Shared versioned row edits and query contracts across TanStack Table, Tabulator and Glide, plus MiniSearch indexing and uPlot with semantic fallbacks.

profiles: Node 24.19.0 + React/ReactDOM 18.3.1; TypeScript build and five tests covering versioned edit batches, query validation, real MiniSearch updates, aligned time series and real TanStack v9 server rendering.
notes: Stable Glide 6.0.3 limits this combined pack to React 18; React 19 is unsupported by this profile.
Tabulator/Glide browser editing, uPlot canvas/resize and device/accessibility acceptance were not exercised; semantic previews are bounded and need server pagination for full datasets.
